theorems.name: move_at_most_travel
theorems.doc: (S) No command drives more than a full travel.
theorems.statement:
theorem move_at_most_travel (st : Blind) (c : Cmd) :
    plan st c ⦃ r => r.2.steps.val ≤ 4450 ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem move_at_most_travel (st : Blind) (c : Cmd) :
    plan st c ⦃ r => r.2.steps.val ≤ 4450 ⦄ := by
  have hh := height_val
  rcases c with n | n | _ | _ <;> simp only [plan, lift, bind_ok]
  · step* <;> blind_auto
  · step* <;> blind_auto
  · step* <;> blind_auto
  · by_cases h1 : st.pos.val ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT.val
    · have : st.pos ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT := by scalar_tac
      simp [this]
    · have : ¬ st.pos ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT := by scalar_tac
      simp only [this, if_false]
      step* <;> blind_auto

theorems.name: lower_stops_at_bottom
theorems.doc: (S) From inside the travel, `Lower` stops at the bottom: it never drives past it (upstream drives a full travel from wherever a jog left the blind).
theorems.statement:
theorem lower_stops_at_bottom (st : Blind) (hin : st.pos.val ≤ 4450) :
    plan st .Lower ⦃ r => st.pos.val + r.2.steps.val = 4450 ∧ r.1.pos.val = 4450 ∧ r.2.up = false ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem lower_stops_at_bottom (st : Blind) (hin : st.pos.val ≤ 4450) :
    plan st .Lower ⦃ r => st.pos.val + r.2.steps.val = 4450 ∧ r.1.pos.val = 4450 ∧ r.2.up = false ⦄ := by
  have hh := height_val
  simp only [plan]
  by_cases h1 : st.pos.val ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT.val
  · have : st.pos ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT := by scalar_tac
    simp [this]; omega
  · have : ¬ st.pos ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT := by scalar_tac
    simp only [this, if_false]
    step* <;> blind_auto

theorems.name: raise_to_top
theorems.doc: (S) `Raise` drives up exactly to the top from inside the travel.
theorems.statement:
theorem raise_to_top (st : Blind) (hin : st.pos.val ≤ 4450) :
    plan st .Raise ⦃ r => r.2.steps.val = st.pos.val ∧ r.1.pos.val = 0 ∧ r.2.up = true ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem raise_to_top (st : Blind) (hin : st.pos.val ≤ 4450) :
    plan st .Raise ⦃ r => r.2.steps.val = st.pos.val ∧ r.1.pos.val = 0 ∧ r.2.up = true ⦄ := by
  have hh := height_val
  simp only [plan]
  step* <;> blind_auto

theorems.name: idle_at_limits
theorems.doc: (S) A command at a limit it would drive past does nothing: `Lower` at or past the bottom, `Raise` at the top.
theorems.statement:
theorem idle_at_limits (st : Blind) :
    (st.pos.val ≥ 4450 → ∃ st', plan st .Lower = ok (st', { up := false, steps := 0#u32 })) ∧
    (st.pos.val = 0 → plan st .Raise = ok ({ pos := 0#u32 }, { up := true, steps := 0#u32 }))
theorems.proof:
theorem idle_at_limits (st : Blind) :
    (st.pos.val ≥ 4450 → ∃ st', plan st .Lower = ok (st', { up := false, steps := 0#u32 })) ∧
    (st.pos.val = 0 → plan st .Raise = ok ({ pos := 0#u32 }, { up := true, steps := 0#u32 })) := by
  have hh := height_val
  constructor
  · intro h
    have : st.pos ≥ BLIND_HEIGHT := by scalar_tac
    exact ⟨st, by simp [plan, this]⟩
  · intro h
    have hz : st.pos = 0#u32 := by scalar_tac
    unfold plan min
    simp [hz]
    split_ifs <;> simp <;> scalar_tac

theorems.name: microsteps_saturate
theorems.doc: (C) The microstep count never wraps (upstream's `n * microsteps` wraps with overflow checks off): the product when it fits, else u32::MAX.
theorems.statement:
theorem microsteps_saturate (s p : Std.U32) :
    microsteps s p ⦃ r => (s.val * p.val ≤ 2 ^ 32 - 1 → r.val = s.val * p.val) ∧
      (2 ^ 32 - 1 < s.val * p.val → r.val = 2 ^ 32 - 1) ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem microsteps_saturate (s p : Std.U32) :
    microsteps s p ⦃ r => (s.val * p.val ≤ 2 ^ 32 - 1 → r.val = s.val * p.val) ∧
      (2 ^ 32 - 1 < s.val * p.val → r.val = 2 ^ 32 - 1) ⦄ := by
  have hs : s.val ≤ 2 ^ 32 - 1 := by scalar_tac
  have hp : p.val ≤ 2 ^ 32 - 1 := by scalar_tac
  have hprod : s.val * p.val ≤ (2 ^ 32 - 1) * (2 ^ 32 - 1) := Nat.mul_le_mul hs hp
  have hr : U32.rMax = 4294967295 := by first | rfl | decide | simp [U32.rMax]
  unfold microsteps
  step* <;> (try simp only [hr] at *) <;> (constructor <;> intro <;> (try simp_all) <;> (try scalar_tac) <;> omega)

theorems.name: estimate_follows
theorems.doc: (S) A jog down moves the estimate by the steps driven, at most a full travel, downwards.
theorems.statement:
theorem estimate_follows (st : Blind) (n : Std.U32) :
    plan st (.Backward n) ⦃ r => r.2.up = false ∧ r.2.steps.val ≤ 4450 ∧ st.pos.val ≤ r.1.pos.val ⦄
theorems.proof:
theorem estimate_follows (st : Blind) (n : Std.U32) :
    plan st (.Backward n) ⦃ r => r.2.up = false ∧ r.2.steps.val ≤ 4450 ∧ st.pos.val ≤ r.1.pos.val ⦄ := by
  have hh := height_val
  simp only [plan, lift, bind_ok]
  step* <;> (try exact ⟨by omega, sat_mono _ _⟩) <;> blind_auto

theorems.name: ramp
theorems.doc: (C) The first and last 100 microsteps are slow.
theorems.statement:
theorem ramp (i n : Std.U32) (h : i.val < 100 ∨ i.val + 100 ≥ n.val) (hi : i.val + 100 < 2 ^ 32) :
    slow_step i n = ok true
theorems.proof:
theorem ramp (i n : Std.U32) (h : i.val < 100 ∨ i.val + 100 ≥ n.val) (hi : i.val + 100 < 2 ^ 32) :
    slow_step i n = ok true := by
  unfold slow_step
  by_cases h1 : i < 100#u32
  · simp [h1]
  · have hv := sat_val i 100#u32
    have h100 : (100#u32 : Std.U32).val = 100 := by rfl
    have hlt : ¬ i.val < 100 := by scalar_tac
    have hge : n.val ≤ (core.num.U32.saturating_add i 100#u32).val := by
      rw [hv, h100]; omega
    have hge' : core.num.U32.saturating_add i 100#u32 ≥ n := by scalar_tac
    simp [h1, lift, hge, hge']

slow_step.lean:
def slow_step (i : Std.U32) (n : Std.U32) : Result Bool := do
  if i < 100#u32
  then ok true
  else let i1 ← lift (core.num.U32.saturating_add i 100#u32)
       ok (i1 >= n)

upstream.code: let speed = if i < 100 || i >= n - 100 { slow } else { fast };

slow_step.upstream_note: the ramp: the first and last 100 microsteps slow

Blind.upstream_note: upstream keeps only `raised`; the port tracks the position in steps from the top (U1)

Cmd.lean:
@[discriminant isize]
inductive Cmd where
| Forward : Std.U32 → Cmd
| Backward : Std.U32 → Cmd
| Raise : Cmd
| Lower : Cmd

plan.lean:
def plan (st : Blind) (cmd : Cmd) : Result (Blind × Move) := do
  match cmd with
  | Cmd.Forward n =>
    let n1 ← min n BLIND_HEIGHT
    if st.pos > n1
    then let pos ← st.pos - n1
         ok ({ pos }, { up := true, steps := n1 })
    else ok ({ pos := 0#u32 }, { up := true, steps := n1 })
  | Cmd.Backward n =>
    let n1 ← min n BLIND_HEIGHT
    let pos ← lift (core.num.U32.saturating_add st.pos n1)
    ok ({ pos }, { up := false, steps := n1 })
  | Cmd.Raise =>
    let i ← min st.pos BLIND_HEIGHT
    ok ({ pos := 0#u32 }, { up := true, steps := i })
  | Cmd.Lower =>
    if st.pos >= BLIND_HEIGHT
    then ok (st, { up := false, steps := 0#u32 })
    else
      let i ← BLIND_HEIGHT - st.pos
      ok ({ pos := BLIND_HEIGHT }, { up := false, steps := i })
plan.upstream_note: motor_task's raised check and its (dir, n): the port plans from the position and caps at a full travel (U1, U3)

Move.lean:
structure Move where
  up : Bool
  steps : Std.U32

microsteps.upstream_note: n * microsteps, saturated (upstream's usize product wraps)

min.lean:
def min (a : Std.U32) (b : Std.U32) : Result Std.U32 := do
  if a < b
  then ok a
  else ok b
min.upstream_note: port-only helper: the cap at a full travel (upstream drives any usize, U3)
